title: Draft preview iframe opens its own assistant dock (shared sessionStorage), so an iterate turn shows two assistants and squeezes the list to ~200px at 1024px
body:
Filing gate **① a reproduced UX defect** (class a, public door: the in-app assistant). `reach:` one browser at 1024×768, local stack, cloud PR #3297 head `4e7ee6d5` + framework pin `6390fe52`, zh-CN, 2026-10-27. On an app's list page with the 助手 dock open, I asked the assistant to add a table. A 「草稿预览」 pane opened automatically. It is an `<iframe>` of the full console, and inside it the app's **own 助手 dock was also open**. Result: two assistants on screen, three columns, the record list squeezed to ~200 px (the page title cut to 「装修…」).

Batch-of: 5 · 2026-10-27 re-test of the 2026-10-25 desktop E2E after the fixes. Filed at the maintainer's request: 「完整的再测试一遍」 / 「必要的合理的建议都可以立卡」. Reviewed in-session before filing.

**Business reason.** "Ask the assistant to change my app" is the second thing every customer does. At a common laptop width the preview that is meant to show the change instead shows a second copy of the chat, and the real page becomes unusable until the preview is closed.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:ui` seat: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout`.

## Where (pin `6390fe52`; unchanged on objectstack `main`)
- The dock's open state is `sessionStorage['ai-chat-dock-expanded']` (`app-shell/src/layout/chatDockState.ts:23`, read :82). A same-origin iframe shares the tab's sessionStorage.
- `ConsoleLayout.tsx:158` reads it unconditionally, and :241-243 mounts `ChatDockPanel` whenever `dockEnabled && dock.expanded && !isMobile`. Nothing checks `?preview=draft` or `window.self !== window.top`.
- `console/ai/LiveCanvas.tsx:65-70` iframes the full console at `/apps/<seg>?preview=draft`.
- Arithmetic: parent dock 420 px (`DOCK_DEFAULT_WIDTH`, chatDockState.ts:35) + iframe dock 420 px leaves ≈ 200 px for the list at 1024 px, which matches the screen.

## Expected
A console rendered inside a `?preview=draft` iframe mounts no chat dock and no FAB, and arguably no sidebar/topbar chrome either. The preview shows the app, not the console around it.

## Dedupe
`gh api search/issues` on objectstack and cloud, incl. closed:
- objectstack `preview iframe dock assistant`: 0.
- objectstack `草稿预览 助手 iframe`: 0.
- objectstack `ChatDock iframe`: 0.
- objectstack `DOCK_EXPANDED_STORAGE_KEY`: 0.
- cloud `草稿预览 两个助手`: 0.
